response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and jovial man named KING REGINALD, is pacing back and forth in front of a grand, ornate mirror.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Something's missing, my friends. Something's missing.

Suddenly, a court jester, JESTER JACK, approaches the king.

JESTER JACK
Your Majesty, what seems to be the matter?

KING REGINALD
I don't know, Jack. I just feel like our kingdom's aesthetic is, well, a bit...stale.

JESTER JACK
Stale, Your Majesty? But our kingdom is the epitome of grandeur!

KING REGINALD
Grandeur, yes, but also...tired. Like a worn-out tapestry. I want something new, something...vaporwave.

JESTER JACK
Vaporwave, Your Majesty? I'm not sure I understand.

KING REGINALD
Never mind, Jack. Just get me the royal architect.

CUT TO:

INT. ROYAL ARCHITECT'S OFFICE - DAY

The royal architect, ARCHITECT ALBERT, is a bespectacled man with a wild shock of hair.

ARCHITECT ALBERT
Your Majesty, I'm not sure I can make this work. Vaporwave is a bit...unconventional.

KING REGINALD
Unconventional? Ha! That's the point, Albert. I want our kingdom to be a reflection of the future, of the world to come.

ARCHITECT ALBERT
But, Your Majesty, what about the grand halls, the castle walls? They're, well, quite...medieval.

KING REGINALD
Medieval? Ha! Those are just relics of the past. I want our kingdom to be a fusion of old and new, of tradition and...futurism.

ARCHITECT ALBERT
I see, Your Majesty. And what exactly do you envision?

KING REGINALD
I envision a kingdom that's...dreamlike. A kingdom that's...hypnotic. A kingdom that's...vaporwave.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The grand halls are now filled with fog machines, and the castle walls are adorned with neon lights. The knights are now dressed in futuristic armor, and the merchants are selling strange, glowing wares.

KING REGINALD
(to the court)
Behold, my friends! Our kingdom is now a true marvel of the future!

JESTER JACK
Your Majesty, it's...um... quite something.

KING REGINALD
Quite something? Ha! It's...vaporwave, Jack! It's the future!

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is sitting on his throne, surrounded by his courtiers. They're all dressed in their finest, most futuristic attire.

KING REGINALD
(to his courtiers)
I want our kingdom to be a beacon of hope, of progress. I want our people to be inspired by our...vaporwave aesthetic.

COURTIER 1
Yes, Your Majesty. We will make sure to spread the word.

KING REGINALD
Good. And I want our kingdom to be a place where...he, she, they can come to escape the mundane, the ordinary.

COURTIER 2
Yes, Your Majesty. We will make sure to create a...vaporwave utopia.

KING REGINALD
A vaporwave utopia? Ha! That's exactly what I want.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a true marvel of the future. The people are all dressed in their finest, most futuristic attire, and the air is filled with the sweet scent of...vaporwave.

KING REGINALD
(to the camera)
Welcome to my kingdom, where...he, she, they can come to experience the...vaporwave of the future.

FADE TO BLACK.
